description: Get a one-time payment address for a deposit into the account's Arc home, the same Relay deposit app.felix.trade uses (also a brand-new account's first deposit before its Arc home is set up). Pay exactly from_amount of from_currency on that token's own network before the window ends; it arrives as USDC in the Arc home Safe, which this client re-derives from the owner key and checks before showing any address. Moves no money itself. A first deposit must deliver at least $5.

account_id.description: Optional owned child account UUID. Omit for the active account.

from_amount.description: Amount of from_currency you will send.

from_currency.description: Deposit token key from get_deposit_address list_currencies, for example usdc_base.

idempotency_key.description: Required. Reuse it after a timeout to get the same instruction back, never a second one.

name: create_deposit
